p, k = map(int, input().split())

MOD = 1000000007

parent_nodes = [i for i in range(p)]
count_components = 0

def find_parent(x):
    if parent_nodes[x] != x:
        parent_nodes[x] = find_parent(parent_nodes[x])
    return parent_nodes[x]

def union_sets(a, b):
    global count_components
    a = find_parent(a)
    b = find_parent(b)
    if a == b:
        return
    count_components -= 1
    parent_nodes[b] = a

def mod_exp(base, exp):
    result = 1
    base %= MOD
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            result = (result * base) % MOD
        base = (base * base) % MOD
        exp >>= 1
    return result

if k == 0:
    print(mod_exp(p, p - 1))
else:
    count_components = p - (1 if k > 1 else 0)
    for i in range(1, p):
        parent_nodes[i] = i
    for i in range(1, p):
        union_sets(i, (i * k) % p)
    print(mod_exp(p, count_components))
